description: This file defines the DVB EIT (Event Information Table) class and its nested ServiceIterator class, including constants, enums, and methods for parsing and iterating over DVB EIT data structures related to broadcast services.

classes.name: Thunder::Broadcast::DVB::EIT
classes.description: Represents the DVB Event Information Table, providing access to service information and iteration over contained services.

classes.name: Thunder::Broadcast::DVB::EIT::ServiceIterator
classes.description: Iterator class for traversing services within an EIT data segment.

methods.name: EIT::ServiceIterator::IsValid
methods.description: Checks if the current iterator position is valid.

methods.name: EIT::ServiceIterator::Next
methods.description: Advances the iterator to the next service.

methods.name: EIT::ServiceIterator::ServiceId
methods.description: Returns the service ID of the current service.

methods.name: EIT::ServiceIterator::Descriptors
methods.description: Returns an iterator over descriptors associated with the current service.

methods.name: EIT::Services
methods.description: Returns an iterator over services in the EIT.

methods.name: EIT::OriginalNetworkId
methods.description: Returns the original network ID from the EIT data.
